news.title: OpenAI introduced OpenAI for Healthcare
news.summary: OpenAI announced OpenAI for Healthcare, including ChatGPT for Healthcare and HIPAA-oriented enterprise controls.

news.title: Microsoft announced agentic AI for retail automation
news.summary: Microsoft detailed agentic AI solutions aimed at automating retail workflows and operations across functions.

news.title: Red Hat published a practical guide to MCP for agentic AI
news.summary: Red Hat explained how MCP standardizes tool calling and helps teams make agents governable with policy, identity, and auditability.

news.title: OpenAI signed a major compute deal with Cerebras
news.summary: Reuters reported OpenAI will purchase cloud services backed by Cerebras chips, underscoring the race for inference and reasoning compute.

news.title: Cursor shipped CLI improvements including MCP management
news.summary: Cursor's changelog highlighted new CLI controls (including MCP enable/disable) plus performance and workflow improvements.

news.title: Replit expanded Agent automation previews and added new model integrations
news.summary: Replit shipped an automation preview for Agent builders and added new AI model options inside Integrations.

news.title: CES coverage highlighted the rise of 'physical AI'
news.summary: Reuters reported renewed focus on robotics and 'physical AI' at CES, with chip and platform vendors positioning for the next wave.

news.title: Vibe coding tool landscape pieces started consolidating the category
news.summary: A wave of 2026 'vibe coding' comparisons summarized how tools like Cursor and Replit are changing app-building workflows for small teams.

news.title: Anthropic announced an expanded Labs product incubation org
news.summary: Anthropic described a Labs expansion focused on incubating experimental products and highlighted MCP and Claude Code as key frontier bets.

news.title: Zuplo published a 'State of MCP' adoption and security survey
news.summary: Zuplo surveyed MCP builders and found rising adoption expectations alongside security and auth as the biggest blocker.

news.title: Deepgram raised $130M at a $1.3B valuation
news.summary: Reuters reported voice AI startup Deepgram raised $130 million, highlighting continued funding for applied AI infrastructure.

news.title: Thomson Reuters convened a Trust in AI Alliance focused on agentic systems
news.summary: Thomson Reuters announced a forum to advance trust and accountability for intelligent and agentic AI systems in professional workflows.
